title: Shopify integration key sent to every visitor in the brandDetails cookie
evidence: curl -s -D - https://mittenclub.shopmitten.com/: Set-Cookie brandDetails still sent to a fresh client with only Path=/ (no HttpOnly, no Secure). URL-decoded JSON still holds apiKey (a 280-char JWT) and integration {name:"shopify", primary_access_key: 32 hex chars, secondary_access_key: <store>.myshopify.com}. Values not used. Sanity note: the key has no shpat_/shpss_ prefix, so it could be a public Storefront or app key; Critical assumes it is secret, so the developer should confirm.

title: Password-reset link still usable after use; reset JWT has no expiry
evidence: Stronger than first reported. (1) Reopened the ORIGINAL reset link (issued 10:41 PM PT Sep 26, already used in C14): form rendered, a new password was accepted, login with it succeeded and the previous password was rejected. (2) New reset request at 12:06 AM: link used once (API: "Your password has been successfully updated"), then reopened and a second password submitted: accepted again, login with it succeeded. JWT payload keys {data, iat}: no exp. Only test-inbox links on the test account; new password kept only in test-inbox.json.

title: /aropay ships a hardcoded Aeropay DEV token and sandbox URL (page blank)
evidence: curl /aropay -> 200; page chunk aropay-*.js still hardcodes https://dev.aerosync.com/?token=<JWT>. Claims: jti, exp, userId, userPassword, ClientId, ClientName, sessionId; exp 2023-09-25 (expired). Re-crawl: body text 0 chars, console CSP frame-ancestors error, request net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_RESPONSE.

title: Shop search is an unfinished template: no search box, "Lorem Ipsum", no results or empty state
evidence: curl shopmitten.com/search?q=hoodie and ?q=zzqx: h1 "Lorem Ipsum" plus a lorem blurb, 0 product links, no "no results" text. Home page HTML has no search input and no /search link.

title: Collections have no sort control and ignore sort_by
evidence: curl /collections/all?filter.v.availability=1 with no sort, sort_by=price-ascending and price-descending: same order all 3 times (61 products: Lighter $5, Water Bottle $10, Bomber $40 ...). products.json shows $3 keychains exist. No sort control in the HTML.

title: Shop "Reward" widget is not connected to the Mitten Club account
evidence: Playwright 1280x800, fresh context: clicked the floating Reward launcher (Yotpo), then Join now. Lands on shopify.com/authentication/.../login "Sign in or create an account" with "Email me with news and offers" pre-checked. No points shown. Sanity note: Yotpo is working as designed on Shopify customer accounts. The defect is that there are 2 unlinked programs both called "Mitten Club". High is arguable (integration gap).

title: /campaign crashes for logged-in members ("data is not defined")
evidence: Logged in as the test account (email + password), opened /campaign: "Sorry We Detected An Issue". Console: ReferenceError: data is not defined (chunk 1008.*.js), Next.js client-side exception, "Missing required parameters: sitekey".

title: /collectibles is empty for members
evidence: Logged in, opened /collectibles: main area shows only "trending" and "product lines". No items and no empty-state message.

title: Mitten Club newsletter signup is broken everywhere (footer goes to login, sidebar JS error, /newsletter blank)
evidence: A: footer SIGN UP TODAY is <a href="/profile/account"> and lands on /login/password/email?from=%2Fprofile%2Faccount. B: mobile 390x844 sidebar button (onclick alpanaModal) throws pageerror "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'style')" and nothing opens. C: /newsletter iframe src="[object Object]" requests /[object%20Object] -> 404; body is header and footer only (384 chars).

title: Header "Validate" button does nothing (desktop and mobile)
evidence: Clicked the Validate pill at 1366x900 and at 390x844 (fresh contexts): URL unchanged, DOM hash unchanged, 0 non-analytics requests. The element is a <div> with no link.

title: Store page "SHOP NOW" fails with an error toast (hubId null)
evidence: /locations/315%20North, clicked SHOP NOW: toast "Sorry! Cannot process your request. Try again". PUT set-hub body {"payload":{"hubId":null,"type":"PICKUP"}} returned HTTP 200 {"success":false,"error":"\"hubId\" must be a number"}.

title: Marketing consent pre-ticked; no way to manage it in the club profile
evidence: Shopify checkout contact step: marketing_opt_in pre-checked. Shopify sign-in reached from the Reward widget: marketing-consent pre-checked. /register terms checkbox pre-checked. /profile/account (logged in) has no newsletter, marketing or SMS setting.

title: Registration: phone is required but not marked, not formatted, error only on submit
evidence: /register: no required marker on phone; typed 3135550142 and it stayed unformatted; terms box pre-ticked. Submitted with phone empty and the existing test email, so no account was created: "Phone is required". Correction: the error also appears as soon as the field is touched and left empty, not only on submit. Issue text adjusted.

title: Sign-up code step is confusing and ends looking logged out
evidence: Needs a brand-new sign-up with a second phone number. The only fictional number (313-555-0142) is already on the test account, so no new account was created. Supporting evidence from the original run in the test inbox: "Welcome to Mitten" 10:36:49 PM PT arrived before "Mitten: one time code to login" 10:36:50 PM PT.

title: Password reset and login give almost no feedback
evidence: Saving a new password from a reset link shows the toast "Successfully changed your password / Login with your new password" (seen twice) and redirects to login. A failed login shows "Login Failed / Username or Password Incorrect" for about 3 s. The original screenshot was taken after the toast had faded. What is left (toast only, no inline error) is a style preference, not a defect.

title: Joining is hard to find: logo-only first screen, "Join Today" opens login
evidence: Home at 1280x800: the only text above the fold is the nav and "Validate" (the logo is an image). Join Today is <a href="/profile/account"> and lands on /login/password/email?from=%2Fprofile%2Faccount.

title: Rewards page does not explain redemption; tier shown only on the account page
evidence: Logged in, /profile/rewards: 0 pts; earn paths listed (profile 300, app 200, scan campaigns 25/50, referral). The word "redeem" appears nowhere and no tier is shown. The tier (BRONZE, 0/1000) is only on /profile/account.

title: Product verification hides its 10-character rule until the field loses focus
evidence: /verify: no rule shown before or while typing. After blur: "Code must be exactly 10 characters". VERIFY is disabled at 5 chars with no reason given and enabled at 10. The header says Validate; the page says VERIFY PRODUCT.

title: Dispensary finder has no search or filter
evidence: /dispensaries: 0 input fields (no search or filter), long unfiltered list, page title "ShopMitten".

title: Cart and drawer discount field does not validate or carry the code
evidence: Cart discount field is name="attributes[discount_code]" (a cart attribute, not a discount). Apply sends no request and shows "Code is applied at checkout.". At checkout no code is prefilled or applied (TESTCODE123 absent).

title: Floating "Reward" button covers hero text, size chips and product cards
evidence: Partly corrected. At 1280x800 the launcher (x 1131-1256, y 720-776) does not overlap hero copy or size chips at rest. The original journey window was actually 1024x525; there the launcher sits on hero paragraph text (S03 screenshot). It never covers the size chips (chips end at x=985). Issue text adjusted; severity arguably Low.

title: Product page: sold-out sizes unlabeled, size guide incomplete, copy wrong
evidence: Classic 1 Hoodie Grey: S/M/L inputs disabled and struck through, no "Sold out" text or label. Size guide shows cm/kg columns only and sizes S-XXL (no 3XL although 3XL is sold). Description says "design 3" and "Available in black, white, and grey" on the Heather Gray product. Horizontal scroll in the size guide was not reproduced at 1280x800.
